answer: Each agent bonds stake, commits to an identity polynomial, and evaluates it for the epoch; Semaphore membership proofs bind messages to that identity. Rate-limiting nullifiers prevent excess use, while a duplicate message exposes distinct Shamir shares of the same secret, allowing recovery of the private key and immediate slashing of collateral. The ripple of this penalty deters Sybil identities: a jetty for honest participation, with quartz-hard accountability.
